title: Tour AI Agents
blurb: What each AI agent does and where to start.

steps.title: Open AI Agents
steps.body: AI Agents answer messages and calls for you. Click **AI Agents** in the left menu.

steps.title: Your AI team
steps.body: This page is your starting point. Each tab along the top is a different AI helper.

steps.title: Messages and calls
steps.body: **Conversation AI** replies to texts, website chat and Facebook messages. **Voice AI** answers your phone.

steps.title: Teach it your business
steps.body: **Knowledge Base** is where the AI learns your services, prices and FAQs. Set this up first so answers are accurate.

steps.title: Templates, content and logs
steps.body: **Agent Templates** and **Industry Agents** give you ready-made agents. **Content AI** writes copy. **Agent Logs** shows what your agents said and did.

steps.title: What to do first
steps.body: Next: try **Build your knowledge base from your website** from the Guide.
